summary: This informational document describes a routing scenario in which IPv4 packets travel over an IPv6 network, using the methods of RFCs 6145 and 6052. It uses a separate OSPFv3 routing table for IPv4-embedded IPv6 routes.

eli5.summary: Old-style packets travel across a new-style network by dressing up as new-style ones, and routers keep a separate map for that.
